name: Ferienhotel Fuchs
beschreibung:
Located on the sunny outskirts of Soell, the traditional Ferienhotel Fuchs pairs welcoming living comfort with restorative wellness. Well-appointed rooms, a relaxing spa, and tasty regional dining delight guests from near and far.

The Soell gondola base is quickly reached, opening up boundless skiing in winter and family adventures at Hexenwasser alongside scenic mountain trails in summer.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienhotel Fuchs in Soell offers warm Tyrolean hospitality, wellness relaxation, and direct access to SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser.
